description: A wet street outside an old red-brick prison with towers and a huge arched wooden gate. A young man in a black bomber jacket, grey hoodie and black trousers walks out of the small open door carrying a plastic bag of belongings, shading his eyes against the daylight, then smiles. A uniformed guard stands in the doorway behind him. A friend in a dark jacket runs up the street from a parked car, and the two men hug tightly on the pavement.
